xmldoc.short_description: Argon2 password hashing and key derivation.

param_input_item.param_description: a uint8 vector (raw bytes) or a character vector (UTF-8 bytes): secret to hash.
a uint8 vector (raw bytes) or a character vector (UTF-8 bytes): at least 8 bytes, 16 random bytes recommended, unique per password.
memory cost in KiB, at least 8 times the number of lanes (default: 65536, that is 64 MiB).
degree of parallelism of the algorithm, at least 1 (default: 1); the computation itself is single threaded.
output length in bytes, between 4 and 1024 (default: 32).
optional secret key (pepper) as uint8 or text, mixed into the hash.
optional associated data as uint8 or text, mixed into the hash.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: 2 * Length lowercase hexadecimal characters.

description.p: crypto.argon2 computes an Argon2 hash (RFC 9106), the memory-hard function recommended for password storage and for deriving encryption keys from passphrases. Store the salt and the parameters next to the hash: verifying a password means recomputing the hash with the same inputs and comparing.

The defaults (argon2id, 64 MiB, 3 passes, 1 lane) take a fraction of a second on a desktop machine; raise Memory or Passes for stronger protection, lower them only for tests. The work area is allocated for each call and wiped afterwards.

example_item.example_item_description: hash a passphrase (small parameters for the example)
